description: This file defines a Flutter widget named InviteFriendsFragment that provides UI for inviting friends via referral code, sharing, and SMS functionality. It includes UI elements like headers, referral code display with copy functionality, share button, and SMS invite button.

classes.name: InviteFriendsFragment
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds the UI for the invite friends screen with referral code sharing, copying, and SMS invite features.

methods.name: _shareApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch the SMS URI with the share message, providing a fallback error message.

methods.name: _sendSMS
methods.description: Attempts to send an SMS with the invitation message, handling errors if unable to open SMS app.
